faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about MarkIt Studio.

items.q: Are my photos or videos uploaded to any server?
items.a: Never! MarkIt operates entirely on client-side Web APIs and HTML5 Canvas. Your files remain exclusively on your computer or mobile device.

items.q: How many files can I process in a batch?
items.a: You can process multiple files in a single queue. Processing capacity depends solely on your local device RAM.
Images: JPEG, PNG, WebP, and SVG. Videos: MP4 and WebM files natively decodable by your browser.
No. The watermark is composited at the original pixel resolution of each source image.

items.q: Does MarkIt work smoothly on mobile phones?
items.a: Yes! The interface is fully responsive, touch-friendly, and installable as a Progressive Web App (PWA).
